name: hcportal_previewHasherMerge
description: Merge accounts, step 1 (E12.F6.S1): finds two live accounts (Removed = 0) — each by email, or by a hasher id / PublicHasherId pasted in the same box — and returns what each holds and where they overlap, including what the kept account will hold after hcportal_mergeHashers. Read only. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; caller must hold a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanEditKennel = 1.

parameters.name: keepEmail
parameters.description: The account that stays: email, hasher id or PublicHasherId. Blank returns a refusal.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(MAX) vs Hasher.Email NVARCHAR(250); trimmed and lower-cased, also tried as a UNIQUEIDENTIFIER against Hasher.id and Hasher.PublicHasherId.

parameters.name: mergeEmail
parameters.description: The account whose history moves across and which is then disabled: email, hasher id or PublicHasherId. Blank returns a refusal.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(MAX) vs Hasher.Email NVARCHAR(250); trimmed and lower-cased, also tried as a UNIQUEIDENTIFIER against Hasher.id and Hasher.PublicHasherId.

rowsets.name: Refusal
rowsets.description: { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } on auth failure, missing CanEditKennel, a blank box, no live account, more than one live account for an email, or both boxes naming the same account. No other rowset follows.

rowsets.name: Accounts
rowsets.description: On success: two rows, Role 'keep' then 'merge'. A runtime error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

columns.name: KennelsMember
columns.description: Live HasherKennelMap rows with IsMember = 1 (not MembershipExpirationDate)

columns.name: IsPlatformAdmin
columns.description: 1 when the account has a live HC.PlatformAdmin row

rowsets.name: Overlap

columns.name: SharedRuns
columns.description: Runs both have a row for (combined on merge)

columns.name: SharedKennels
columns.description: Kennels both belong to (combined on merge)

columns.name: RunsBothPaid
columns.description: Runs both paid a non-zero amount for — both payments are kept

columns.name: AfterRunsAttended
columns.description: Runs the kept account will have attended after the merge (a run on both, same name, counts once, stronger attendance wins)

columns.name: AfterRunsHared
columns.description: Of those, runs hared (either account's hare flag)

columns.name: AfterKennelsFollowed
columns.description: Kennels followed after the merge (a kennel on both counts once, flags OR-ed)

columns.name: AfterKennelsMember
columns.description: Kennels the kept account is a member of after the merge

columns.name: AfterKennelsAdmin
columns.description: Kennels the kept account is an app admin of (AppAccessFlags & 1) after the merge

rowsets.description: On success: one row of overlaps and of what the kept account holds after the merge (same pairing rules as hcportal_mergeHashers: runs by EventId + DisplayName, kennels by KennelId).

sideEffects: On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog, then THROW

codeSmells.detail: Lines 107-108 (KennelsMember) and 196-200 (AfterKennelsMember) test HasherKennelMap.IsMember; membership is defined by MembershipExpirationDate in the future, so these counts can disagree with what the app and portal call a member.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
